caption: The drawing consists of several stylized elements on a beige background bordered with a wavy pattern of blue and reddish-pink. At the top left, there is a large brown animal resembling a cat or cougar, positioned above a series of brown and blue geometric shapes with blue triangular interiors. Between the geometric shapes are two parallel blue lines and one turquoise line, forming an equals sign. Just below these shapes, a dark brown wavy line runs horizontally across the composition. Underneath this line, three brown deer or antelope with antlers are running from left to right. The area beneath the animals is colored yellow, with three stylized plants or flowers in green, white, pink, and yellow. The lower edge of this yellow area is bordered with a jagged blue and reddish-pink band, and there is also a white irregular shape at the bottom center. Above the running deer, toward the upper right, is a large pink sun or moon next to two green, simple triangular pine trees. There are pink brushstroke shapes scattered throughout the scene, mainly around the top area, and some red handwritten text is located near the sun in the upper right corner.
